parsed.note_claim: The note claims that a helicopter must tilt its rotor disc to move forward, so a video showing forward motion without tilting violates aviation physics.
parsed.label: SUPPORTS
parsed.quote: The cyclic stick controls direction. It changes the blade angle at specific points in each rotation. Thus tilting the rotor disc. When the rotor disc tilts forward, the helicopter moves forward.
parsed.reason: The page directly explains that forward helicopter movement requires tilting the rotor disc forward via cyclic control, substantiating the note's claim that forward flight without rotor disc tilt violates physics.
